timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Everything feels like too much right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is trying to hold all of it at once.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don't have to solve everything in this moment.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can put some of this down, just for now.
I don't have to carry it all by myself.
My body is allowed to loosen a little.
I only have to handle what's in front of me.
I can take this one piece at a time.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm allowing myself to feel a little more capable.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. You don't have to hold onto anything else right now.
